choices: It does not compile - trim() needs an argument
explanation: Strings cannot be changed once made, so trim() cannot modify name - it returns a NEW string with the spaces removed and leaves the original alone. Calling it and ignoring the result does nothing at all. The fix is name = name.trim().
hints: Look at what trim() gives back, and at what the code does with it.
Does any String method ever change the string it was called on?
